After earth slowly destroyed itself from wars, chaos and politics, Project StarBorne was created to gather the last of Earth survivors to keep humanity alive, they were taken to an earth like planet called, Alpha Centauri. Your task it to regrow and recreate civilization on an entirely new planet. create towns, build a base, explore unique structures, and make Alpha Centauri your home.

StarBorne is a Sci-Fi story-driven survival crossplay Minecraft server (SMP) for everyone. It features unique survival-friendly and inspiring terrain, custom music to immerse you in its environment. Chapter 1, “Alpha Centauri” is the first world (season 1) of StarBorne. If you join, you’ll automatically receive the highest rank (Pioneer) forever and for free as our server is relatively new.

Our Server offers a unique and simple experience, and QoL features:

- Server Shopping District, “Arcadia” along with upcoming basic mini games
- Veinminer and tree miner
- Heads for decorations
- Keep inventory
- Right click on villagers to pick them up
- Custom terrain with a massive 64 max chunk render distance for even an even more immersive feel.
- Immersive music (can be turned off)
- Web map
- Crossplay between Java Edition and Bedrock Edition
- 3D Audio (Ex. where caves can echo) (Bedrock only) and basic animations (Bedrock Only)
- Custom sounds (Bedrock and Java)
- Grappling Hooks
- Turn concrete powder into concrete with cauldrons
- Backpack storage to keep items in compartments
- Economy based
- Play time rewards
- Fast live chat translation (speak in your native language and have it automatically translate)
- Paste images on item frames
- Sit on stairs/carpets

General features:
- Tpa
- Discord server with a small yet friendly community
- Land claiming
- PvP toggle (Off by default)
- Basic starter items and money as a new player

We also have inventory rollbacks in case of an emergency/bug, and take offsite world backups weekly to keep your progress safe.

Humanity’s second chance begins now.
